purpose_check.topic: To provide precise and friendly answers to HR policy questions for Meridian Maritime shore staff.

topics.evidence_sentence: Full-time shore staff are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
topics.quote: Employees in their probation period (the first 6 months of employment) accrue leave normally but may take no more than 5 days of leave during probation.

topics.evidence_sentence: Employees receive 12 paid sick days per calendar year.
topics.quote: Employees in their probation period (the first 6 months of employment) accrue leave normally but may take no more than 5 days of leave during probation.

topics.evidence_sentence: Birth mothers receive 26 weeks of maternity leave on full pay.
topics.quote: Fathers and partners receive 4 weeks of paternity leave on full pay, which must be taken within 6 months of the birth.

topics.evidence_sentence: Adoptive parents receive 12 weeks of leave on full pay.
topics.quote: Employees receive 5 days of paid leave on the death of an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent, sibling) and 2 days for an extended family member.

topics.evidence_sentence: After 2 years of service an employee may request up to 30 days of unpaid leave in a calendar year.
